tailoring.headline: Backend Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, REST APIs & Enterprise Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and system integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, data pipelines, CI/CD workflows and production troubleshooting. Proven techno-functional delivery bridging business requirements and technical implementation, working with international teams and stakeholders.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Backend Developer (m/w/d) Service & Integration
cover_en.hook: GWS mbH's focus on robust B2B e-commerce solutions tightly integrated with ERP systems directly aligns with my background. With over 5 years of enterprise backend development and systems integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in building scalable APIs and maintaining complex platform architectures.

bullets.label: API & Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed RESTful APIs, OCC Web Services, and designed data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems to ensure seamless data flow across platforms.

bullets.label: Production Support & Troubleshooting
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved complex integration bottlenecks, performed code reviews, and supported production environments to guarantee high stability and maintainability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Analyzed complex customer and business requirements, translated them into functional specifications and robust backend solutions, and communicated risks and technical concepts clearly.

bullets.label: Modern Delivery Workflows
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and version control using Git within agile team structures to deliver reliable software updates.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, making me available to start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my integration and backend expertise can support GWS mbH.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Backend Developer (m/w/d) Service & Integration
cover_de.hook: Die Ausrichtung von GWS mbH auf leistungsstarke B2B-E-Commerce-Lösungen mit enger ERP-Integration spricht mich fachlich sehr an. Mit über 5 Jahren fundierter Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung und Systemintegration bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehende Expertise in der API-Entwicklung und der Betreuung komplexer Unternehmensanwendungen mit.

bullets.label: Service & Integration
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und erweiterte RESTful APIs, Webdienste sowie Datendatei-Pipelines zur nahtlosen Anbindung von ERP- und PIM-Systemen und analysierte komplexe Integrationsszenarien.

bullets.label: Fehleranalyse & Stabilität
bullets.text: Ich ging komplexen Fehlerbildern und Servicefällen nachhaltig auf den Grund, führte Code-Analysen sowie Reviews durch und begleitete Deployments und Releases zur Sicherung der Anwendungsstabilität.

bullets.label: Techno-Funktionale Analyse
bullets.text: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Business-Teams und internationalen Stakeholdern analysierte ich Anforderungen, erstellte Funktionsspezifikationen und übersetzte diese in robuste Softwarelösungen.

bullets.label: Agile Entwicklungsprozesse
bullets.text: Ich steuerte Release-Builds und CI/CD-Deploymentzyklen innerhalb agiler DevOps-Workflows und arbeitete strukturiert mit Git.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein aktuelles Arbeitsverhältnis endet vertragsgemäß zum 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für eine neue Herausforderung zur Verfügung stehe. Gerne überzeuge ich Sie in einem persönlichen Gespräch von meinem Mehrwert für Ihr Team.

tailoring.why_company: GWS mbH combines deep expertise in B2B e-commerce solutions with tight ERP integration, matching my strong background in enterprise backend development, API integration, and system support. I am eager to contribute my experience in solving complex technical challenges, ensuring application stability, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver sustainable value.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of enterprise backend and integration experience, I bring deep expertise in building robust APIs, resolving complex service issues, and bridging technical and business requirements.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of experience in enterprise backend development, REST APIs, and complex system integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the Backend Developer role at GWS mbH. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Bewerbung als Backend Developer (m/w/d) Service & Integration – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Backend Developer (m/w/d) Service & Integration position at GWS mbH. With over 5 years of professional experience in backend development, robust API integrations, and production support at enterprise companies like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident in my ability to add immediate value to your team.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing the role with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
